summary: npm tarball ships self-labeled Windows malware payload (no auto-execution path)
details: Package dakumangalsingh_virus@1.2.0 ships a Windows executable DakuMangalSingh/DakuMangalSingh.exe (455680 bytes, jpackage-built launcher with a bundled JRE) and DakuMangalSingh/app/virus.jar containing Fetch.class, Main.class, and Screenshort.class (screenshot capture). The package name self-labels the payload as a virus. package.json declares main: index.js, but no index.js is present in the tarball, and no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts are declared. Installing the package or calling require() on it does not execute the.exe or the.jar; harm requires a user to manually run DakuMangalSingh.exe from within node_modules.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
